rule: Take the unplaced color with the fewest legal cells (ties: earlier letter), place its first legal cell in reading order, never backtrack. Legal = no shared row, column or color with a placed queen and not touching one.
implementation: scripts/subq/boards.py greedy (frozen); cross-checked against scripts/analysis/build_scoreboard.py greedy
scoring: Scored result stops at the first off-solution queen or an empty menu. Steps marked after_scored_stop continue the same rule without the oracle and are never scored.
